title: CryoTracer: A Synthetic-to-Real System for Filament Instance Tracing in Cryo-EM

problem.summary: Existing methods reconstruct filament trajectories by linking local predictions in a separate post-processing stage, decoupling detection from instance formation and creating potential ambiguities at gaps and crossings.
statements: Existing methods reconstruct filament trajectories by linking local predictions in a separate post-processing stage, decoupling detection from instance formation and creating potential ambiguities at gaps and crossings.
Directly preserving filament identity is particularly useful for polymorphic specimens, where segments originating from the same filament should remain associated.
However, learning such instance-level representations is challenging because expert centerline annotations are scarce and costly to obtain.

components: Starting from RF-DETR weights, we pretrain on procedural micrographs with exact centerline labels.
The generator varies filament geometry, crossings, density, and image appearance, and includes empty fields.
Procedural generation supplies diverse examples without additional manual tracing, providing supervision for learning filament shape and instance separation before adaptation to real data.
